title: Chicago-area AccuWeather Alert for Winter Weather Advisory, several inches of snow accumulation possible in parts area Friday
text:
Chicago weather forecast: Winter Weather Advisory in effect for parts of area with several inches of snow possible | Radar - ABC7 Chicago 
 24/7 Live Chicago & Suburban Cook Co. North Suburbs West Suburbs South Suburbs NW Indiana Snow 
 Chicago weather forecast: Winter Weather Advisory in effect for parts of area for snow | Radar 
 LIVE LOOK AROUND CHICAGO - river camera provided by Royal Sonesta Chicago Downtown By ABC7 Chicago Digital Team Friday, November 13, 2026 12:03PM Share Follow ABC7 on Google CHICAGO (WLS) -- The first snow of the season could create slick conditions for the morning commute Friday.
 ABC7 Accuweather Meteorologist Jaisol Martinez said wet, slushy lake effect snow could accumulate in isolated spots Friday morning, particularly Northwest Indiana and southern suburbs.
 ABC7 Chicago is now streaming 24/7. Click here to watch 
 A Winter Weather Advisory is in effect for southern Cook, eastern Will in Illinois and Lake County in Indiana until noon Friday.
 A lake-effect band of rain formed along the lakefront, with some snowflakes mixed in. Martinez said with lake-effect snow, it could accumulate very quickly if the rain transitions into snow. Martinez said the snow accumulation will mostly be in grassy areas.

 The band of wet weather will continue through the afternoon, and moving to mostly Northwest Indiana in the evening.
 "Crews will be out overnight monitoring arterial streets, DuSable Lake Shore Drive, bridges, and overpasses to ensure roads are safe and passable for emergency vehicles, public transportation, and other travelers," the Chicago Department of Streets and Sanitation said in a statement.
